The report about the Prophet’s first revelation experiences does not explain 6:128.
The dead-goat comparison concerns the world’s worth; its link to 14:38 is lexical only.

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: Ibn ʿUmar reports that the Prophet described Paradise’s lowest-ranked resident viewing its gardens and family a thousand years away, while the most honored sees God morning and evening; he recited 75:22–23.
rows.anchor: ثُمَّ قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tirmidhi notes it is raised in multiple routes through Israel, while another route from Abd al-Malik stops at Ibn ʿUmar; an al-Ashjaʿi–Thawri route through Mujahid also stops there.
rows.anchor: وَرَوَاهُ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبْجَرَ عَنْ ثُوَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ مَوْقُوفٌ

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: Ibn ʿUmar reports that the Prophet described Paradise’s lowest-ranked resident viewing gardens, spouses, servants, and couches a thousand years away, while the most honored sees God morning and evening; he recited 75:22–23.
rows.anchor: ثُمَّ قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tirmidhi grades the report gharīb; multiple routes through Israel raise it to the Prophet, while other routes stop at Ibn ʿUmar, and only al-Thawri’s route mentions Mujahid.
rows.anchor: هَذَا حَدِيثٌ غَرِيبٌ قَدْ رَوَاهُ غَيْرُ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ مِثْلَ هَذَا مَرْفُوعًا

The report about people alive at that time dying within a century does not explain 18:7; the match is lexical.
The report about remembrance and forgiveness does not explain 18:7; the match is lexical only.
The report about supplication and its response does not explain 18:7; the match is lexical only.

words: لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: Saʿd reports that the Prophet identified Jonah’s prayer in the whale’s belly and said that a Muslim who uses it for any need will have it answered; Tirmidhi gives no grade here.
rows.anchor: دعوة ذي النون إذ دعا وهو في بطن الحوت لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn ʿAbbas reports that during Abu Talib’s illness the Prophet asked Quraysh to profess one God, promising Arab allegiance and non-Arab jizya; they refused. Tirmidhi links their response to Ṣād 38:2–7 and grades the report ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ.
rows.anchor: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ مَرِضَ أَبُو طَالِبٍ فَجَاءَتْهُ قُرَيْشٌ

none: The report gives expiation for shaving during ihram and does not explain 36:69; the match is lexical only.

words: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ
rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: Asma bint Yazid reports that the Prophet recited the verse, adding “and He does not mind”; Tirmidhi grades it ḥasan gharīb, knows it only through Thabit–Shahr, and identifies Umm Salama al-Ansariyya as Asma.
rows.anchor: عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْرَأُ

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: Al-Nuʿman b. Bashir reports that the Prophet called supplication worship and then recited the verse; Tirmidhi grades the report ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ.
rows.anchor: النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ الدُّعَاءُ هُوَ الْعِبَادَةُ

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: Al-Nuʿman b. Bashir reports that the Prophet called supplication worship and recited the verse; Tirmidhi grades it ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ, says it is known only through Dharr, whom he calls trustworthy.
rows.anchor: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الدُّعَاءُ هُوَ الْعِبَادَةُ

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: Ibn ʿUmar reports that the Prophet recited this verse and 43:14 when mounting for travel, then prayed for piety, accepted deeds, an easier journey, and protection for companions and family; Tirmidhi grades the report ḥasan gharīb from this route.
rows.anchor: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا سَافَرَ فَرَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ كَبَّرَ ثَلاَثًا

rows.speaker: أبو هريرة
rows.claim: Abu Hurayra reports that Quraysh polytheists disputed predestination with the Prophet and 54:49 was revealed; the segment also quotes 54:48. Tirmidhi grades the report ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ.
rows.anchor: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ مُشْرِكُو قُرَيْشٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُخَاصِمُونَ فِي الْقَدَرِ

rows.speaker: أبو هريرة
rows.claim: Abu Hurayra reports that Quraysh polytheists disputed predestination with the Prophet and 54:49 was revealed; the segment also quotes 54:48. Tirmidhi grades the report ḥasan ṣaḥīḥ.
rows.anchor: قَالَ جَاءَ مُشْرِكُو قُرَيْشٍ يُخَاصِمُونَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْقَدَرِ
